business_summary.text: RACL Geartech is an auto components manufacturer specializing in gears, shafts, and transmission assemblies for two-wheelers, passenger cars, and commercial vehicles, with 75% of revenue from exports.

call_points.text: FY27 CAPEX budgeted at ₹77.45 Cr, focused on new projects
Royal Enfield to ramp up to 20,000 motorcycles from current 10,000
Managing input inflation through customer negotiations and currency benefits

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Automobile and Auto Components > Auto Components > Auto Components & Equipments

operating_notes.text: Royal Enfield 350cc motorcycle gear project to start commercial production August-September 2026
Kawasaki Japan project with 15 parts to start mass production early 2027
BMW electric car projects Titan and Venus to commence mass production October-November 2026
Received export order from Brazil for engine timing gears, entering the Latin American market.

holders.name: ASHOKA INDIA EQUITY INVESTMENT TRUST PLC

timeline.summary: RACL Geartech Limited’s Promoter **Mr. Gursharan Singh** and Promoter Group declared no new encumbrances under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2025-26, filed April 3, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹131.66 Cr, net profit ₹12.35 Cr (+90.0% YoY).
RACL Geartech announced a historic consolidated revenue milestone of ₹512.42 Cr for FY2025-26 on May 27, 2026.
RACL Geartech achieved FY26 revenue of ₹512.42 Cr (+20% YoY), won Royal Enfield and Kawasaki projects, and announced BMW electric car production to start October-November 2026
RACL Geartech received an export order from Brazil for engine timing gears, marking its entry into the Latin American market.

upcoming_events.description: BMW electric car project final sign-off
